name: std::thread::get_id
intro: Returns a value of std::thread::id  identifying the thread associated with *this.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A value of type std::thread::id identifying the thread associated with *this. If there is no thread associated, default constructed std::thread::id is returned.
